'''Llleag'Mak''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kian'thar]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] who operated as one of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's]] most favored lieutenants. After Jabba was killed, Llleag'Mak implemented intimidation and bribery to take control over bits and pieces of Jabba's empire.
